results.text: It restricts the model to consider only the previous and current inputs in a sequence when processing a token, in contrast to ordinary self-attention, which allows access to the entire input sequence at once.
results.reason: Refs state the causal mask lets a current token attend only to current and previous positions, unlike ordinary attention connecting each token to each other token.

results.text: When computing attention for a query token, the model only factors in tokens that occur at or before that token in the sequence.

results.text: The purpose of causal attention is to prevent future tokens from influencing the current token.
